schedule: Strictly sequential outer requests; one fresh migrated DO and one public DO.fetch per case; await every original module promise inside the active request.
F201: Direct call capture(view); synchronously fill backing; await same original promise; no scheduler hook.
F205: Genuine timestamps only; at most32 five-ms waits then explicit strict young>cutoff witness. Missing witness is BLOCKED_WITNESS. Never alter Date.now/storage.

limits.byte_buffer_estimate_scope: Conservative visible-JS payload-view estimate only, not a total memory cap. Native serialization, WebCrypto transient copies, runtime heaps and allocator retention remain covered by the independently enforced aggregate RSS ceiling.
limits.descendant_supervision: Entire proven-owned dev, trusted-bundler and runtime descendant tree across PGIDs; prefer one enforceable cgroup and ownership domain. A single PGID or parent PID is insufficient.
limits.writable_quota_scope: All generated bundles, staging config, logs, temporary files and private store. Do not copy externally supplied read-only source/binaries into the writable domain.

cleanup: Await every capture/read and its digest before marking original trace settled; no streams exist.
If original trace remains unsettled, do not race in-object teardown; external supervisor reaps the entire owned domain.
After settlement open and completely drain one public native sync-KV iterator to replace any abandoned cursor; never call next after done.
DeleteAll only this fresh owned DO and verify KV empty; cleanup failures are typed blockers.
Independently terminate and verify every proven-owned dev/bundler/runtime descendant across PGIDs and remove only owned staging/bundles/logs/temp/private store, regardless of fixture outcome.
runtime_qualification: Exact guarded runtime binary/source/build and immutable vendor/helper/bundle/config witnessed independently
Fresh owned private store and actual object/process identity
Complete externally enforced descendant/resource domain across PGIDs
HTTP200 plus ASSERTIONS_SATISFIED plus nonempty all-true assertions plus traceSettled plus matching object labels plus cleanup COMPLETE
Independent all-descendant termination and owned writable artifact removal
